attributes.description: Milestone 28 (6.2a; read its description and decision 3029, proposal 3024). Core estate domain: ciamEvidenceQuery (ou=evidence-queries) and ciamEvidenceRun, RESERVED numbers attributes 680-689 and classes 143-144 only (reuse existing attributes first: ciamControlRef, ciamManagedBy, ciamEvidenceRef, ciamChangeRef...). Operation `evidence` in operations.py + CLI `opsdir evidence --boundary B [--control C]... [--as-of] -o DIR`: per control a folder of each query's output (CSV + JSON as the report renders it) and MANIFEST.json (control, query, as-of, record history point, SHA-256 per output); deterministic; names and DNs allowed (user), never secrets; the run recorded as a governed ciamEvidenceRun under a change. check_evidence (customer/shared control in a boundary's authorization without a query = action; a query naming an unknown report = blocker; evidence older than its cadence = action), report `evidence`, and the migration planner naming controls whose evidence changes on the target. Showcase: Example Aero's boundary (FedRAMP Moderate / CMMC L2): AC-2 -> principals + access-paths; SC-12/SC-13 -> credentials/keys; AU-2/AU-11 -> audit-trails + log-routes; CM-3 -> change history; evidence package output in golden (snapshot-outputs.sh must produce it: update the script, not only demo.sh). Showcase ids: CHG-2046+, B46+/A140+, data file 25+ (6.3 used 2044/B44/A138/23; 6.4 has 2045/B45/A139/24). Design choices with more than one answer: escalate with a recommendation (the master answers). Rules 2991 + 3002. Boundary: core estate domain, operations.py + CLI command registration for `evidence`, the planner's migration comparison where it names controls, schema LDIF regeneration, docs, examples/showcase, tests. NOT opsdir-format-oscal (worker-1's task), not 6.4's files (worker-2: operations application/graph/summary, governance applications).
